name: EDELTEQ
recent: Edelteq 于11月6日完成以RM15.3百万收购Nixma Technology 51%股权的交易，Nixma成为其子公司。公司同时通过私募配售发行4300万股新股，每股RM0.373，于11月3日上市。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收同比大增209.2%，但净利率从2.1%降至1.6%。
notable: 完成以RM15.3百万收购Nixma Technology 51%股权，Nixma成为子公司。
私募配售4300万股新股，每股RM0.373，于11月3日上市。
2026年6月30日止季度营收同比增209.2%，净利同比增42.7%。
risks: 私募配售发行4300万股新股，占扩大后股本约6.8%，对现有股东构成股权摊薄。
最新季度净利率由2.1%降至1.6%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为RM286.1百万，同比增209.2%，环比增157.6%；净利为RM4.6百万，同比增42.7%，环比增98.8%；净利率为1.6%，低于上一季度的2.1%。

recent_en: Edelteq completed its RM15.3 million acquisition of a 51% stake in Nixma Technology on 6 November, making Nixma a subsidiary. The company also issued 43 million new placement shares at RM0.373 each, listed on 3 November. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 209.2% year-on-year, while net margin fell to 1.6% from 2.1%.
notable_en: Completed the RM15.3 million acquisition of a 51% stake in Nixma Technology, making Nixma a subsidiary.
Private placement of 43 million new shares at RM0.373 each, listed on 3 November.
Revenue for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose 209.2% year-on-year, with net profit up 42.7%.
risks_en: The private placement of 43 million new shares, about 6.8% of the enlarged share base, dilutes existing shareholders.
Net margin for the latest quarter declined to 1.6% from 2.1%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM286.1 million, up 209.2% year-on-year and 157.6% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM4.6 million, up 42.7% year-on-year and 98.8% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 1.6%, down from 2.1% in the previous quarter.
